# QuotaPin 2.0.0-beta.3

This prerelease moves the 2.x placement work onto the v1.3.1 reliability baseline. It does not replace v1.3.1 as Latest and never enters QuotaPin's stable in-product update feed.

- Keep the Composition card geometrically stable while live clocks tick. Time controls now use a fixed semantic grid, so a slightly wider seconds glyph cannot add a row during drag or tab changes.
- Carry forward the Windows detached-updater SHA-256 fix, bounded Agent build preparation, clean first-install teardown, and Windows 11 ARM64 x64-emulation release acceptance.
- Keep the isolated Chromium product gate deterministic on slower hosts with background services disabled, explicit early-exit reporting, and a bounded 90-second startup window.
- Make the local Preview Lab report the version actually present in `VERSION` instead of a stale hardcoded footer.
- Preserve Beta.2 multi-surface placement, surface-following hold gestures, collision-aware module dragging, account/composer quota lines, and opt-in account-wide pace and runway modules.

## Exact-version install

Windows 10 version 2004 or later:

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install.ps1))) -Version '2.0.0-beta.3'
```

macOS:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/QuotaPin-for-Codex/main/install-macos.sh | bash -s -- --version 2.0.0-beta.3
```

The reviewed public assets are `QuotaPin-2.0.0-beta.3.exe` and `QuotaPin-macOS-2.0.0-beta.3.dmg`. The local gate passed 319 tests, production-rendered fixture and forecast captures, a 70-frame drag capture, and an absolute-clock cadence check before tagging. The tagged workflow independently rebuilds and exercises both platform packages. This is an explicit preview cohort: later betas are not installed automatically, and the stable update channel remains on v1.3.1.
